limits.note: per-component file length admission and bounded virtual mappings; not physical allocation, all owner handles, global state/RSS or hard kernel deadlines. Shared mode accounts actual native-page-rounded backing. Cooperating owner coordination is still required for aggregate quotas.
limits.indexBacking: one-byte write per newly backed native page; actual rounded growth is charged and bounded by admitted SHM length, never a physical allocation guarantee

semantics.registration: one non-default process-lifetime VFS with bounded leases, no global syscall replacement; retired contexts held by foreign C files retain their admission reservation
semantics.authority: Storage owns native root/file authority and maps opaque names; real SQLITE_FCNTL_FILE_POINTER method/context/descriptor checks remain available. Test fixtures use independent ordinary metadata and do not prove native mount/provider admission
semantics.locking: production Linux/macOS database and index locks use open-file-description locks with nonblocking conflict behavior; no production process-lock fallback
semantics.index: stable bounded MAP_SHARED mapping; checked initialization, native-page backing, callback locks and checked unmap. Extension treats all nonzero C boolean values as true
semantics.concurrency: custom same-process reader retains its old transaction while a second writer commits/closes; default SQLite interoperability is qualified across independent exec processes only
semantics.defaultSameProcess: not qualified: custom descriptor close can still release a foreign default POSIX client lock in the same process
semantics.provider: native owner must cover the complete synchronous SQL/mapped-page/close interval with provider policy and checked restoration; protecting only callbacks or mmap does not suffice
semantics.retirement: rejects subsequent file I/O but cannot revoke already cached SQLite pages or mapped index bytes
semantics.journalAdapter: preserve journal.db/WAL/rollback/SHM names and EXCLUSIVE schema/wire/replay contracts; relative exclusive creator refuses existing names without reopening/truncating
semantics.auditStore: unchanged default pathname VFS; this slice only delivers the common driver prerequisite. AuditStore actual binding, full policy interval, callback budget and shared 512MiB/4090-name admission remain next work
semantics.windows: AuditStore remains UnsupportedPlatform and event-journal remains Linux-only
semantics.mutation: no target Trash/permanent deletion, permission repair or audit/recovery eviction; final noncooperating relative unlink race remains explicit
